text: 沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞（510300）成交额突破100亿元，为今日第3只成交破百亿的宽基ETF，当前涨幅近2%。创业板ETF易方达（159915）当前成交154亿元、科创50ETF华夏（588000）当前成交141亿元。
text_en: Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF (510300) turnover exceeded 10 billion yuan, making it the third broad-based ETF to exceed 10 billion yuan in turnover today, and it is currently up nearly 2%. E Fund ChiNext ETF (159915) currently has turnover of 15.4 billion yuan, and ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF (588000) currently has turnover of 14.1 billion yuan.
